commands.name: /tribunal
commands.description: Run full Tribunal review on the current file or selection. All 28 reviewers audit in parallel.

commands.name: /tribunal-backend
commands.description: Backend-specific review: Logic + Security + Dependency + Type Safety + Resilience + Schema reviewers.

commands.name: /tribunal-frontend
commands.description: Frontend-specific review: Logic + Security + Frontend + Type Safety + UI/UX + Motion + Visual reviewers.

commands.name: /tribunal-database
commands.description: Database-specific review: Logic + Security + SQL reviewers for Prisma, raw SQL, migrations, ORM operations.

commands.name: /tribunal-performance
commands.description: Performance-specific review: Logic + Performance reviewers for bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals, memory leaks.

commands.name: /summon
commands.description: Summon a specific specialist agent by name. Routes to .agent/agents/{name}.md.

commands.name: /skill
commands.description: Load a specific skill on-demand from the 186-skill library.

commands.name: /audit
commands.description: Full project audit: security scan, lint, schema validation, test coverage, dependency analysis, bundle analysis.

commands.name: /generate
commands.description: Generate code through the Tribunal Anti-Hallucination pipeline. Maker → Reviewers → Human Gate.

commands.name: /debug
commands.description: Systematic 4-phase root cause investigation: Collect → Hypothesize → Test → Fix.

commands.name: /create
commands.description: Create new application from scratch through the full Tribunal pipeline.

commands.name: /enhance
commands.description: Add or update features with impact analysis and breaking change detection.

commands.name: /review
commands.description: Audit existing code for hallucinations without generating anything new.

commands.name: /swarm
commands.description: Multi-agent swarm orchestration. Supervisor decomposes goal into sub-tasks, dispatches to specialist workers.

commands.name: /marathon
commands.description: Long-running agent harness for multi-session projects. Tracks progress across sessions.

commands.name: /pipeline
commands.description: Hybrid 3-Pass code generation: Planner → Builder → Zero-LLM Deterministic Validator.

commands.name: /status
commands.description: Display agent and project status. Shows task progress, last audit results, and recently modified files.

options.lite: Core anti-hallucination only. Fast, minimal overhead.
options.standard: Default. Full Fabel Protocol + Socratic Gate + domain routing.
options.strict: Maximum enforcement. All 28 reviewers on every change. Human Gate mandatory.
options.paranoid: Strict + security scan + dependency audit on every file write.
